blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A benchmark is not merely a collection of test questions; it naturally induces an empirical measure over difficulty. In this work, we develop this measure-based view of benchmark evaluation. This perspective allows us to identify and formalize two central failure modes: measure mismatch, where the benchmark difficulty distribution differs from the intended difficulty distribution, and coverage gaps, where uncovered regions along the difficulty axis prevent benchmarks from detecting meaningful localized training progress. We propose two diagnostic metrics that capture these two failure modes and provide rigorous theoretical guarantees. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains using carefully estimated item difficulties. Our results show that many benchmarks implicitly overweight certain difficulty regions, so their leaderboard conclusions should be interpreted with caution; others leave substantial portions of the difficulty axis uncovered, limiting their ability to monitor the model improvement process. Finally, we turn diagnosis into action by introducing BenchFill, a simple difficulty-targeted item rewriting algorithm that effectively reduces local coverage gaps.
blocks.zh: 基准不仅仅是一个测试问题集;它自然会诱导一种经验性衡量标准,而不是困难。 在这项工作中,我们发展了这种以衡量为基础的基准评价观点。 这一视角使我们能够确定和正式确定两种中心故障模式:衡量不匹配,即基准难度分布与预期难度分布不同;以及覆盖面差距,即困难轴上被揭开的区域阻碍基准发现有意义的局部培训进展。 我们提出两个诊断度量法,捕捉这两个故障模式,并提供严格的理论保证. 从经验上讲,我们利用仔细估计的项目困难,分析跨越7个领域的25个流行基准。 我们的结果显示,许多基准隐含地超重了某些困难区域,因此,应当谨慎地解释其领导板结论;另一些基准则留下了所发现的很大一部分困难轴,限制了它们监测模型改进进程的能力。 最后,我们通过引入BenchFill,将诊断转化为行动,这是一个简单的针对难度的项目重写算法,有效缩小了局部覆盖差距.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Benchmark evaluation looks simple: we run models on a set of questions and average the results. The resulting score is then used in two main ways: to compare models on leaderboards ( Alzahrani et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2018 ; Liang et al., 2022 ; Myrzakhan et al., 2024 ) , and to monitor progress during training ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ; Bercovich et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . But this simplicity hides a basic issue: the conclusion depends not only on how well models perform, but also on how benchmark questions are distributed Siska et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 基准评价看起来很简单:我们在一系列问题上运行模型并平均结果。 由此产生的分数随后主要使用两种方式:在领板上比较模型(Alzahrani等人,2024年;Wang等人,2018年;Liang等人,2022年;Myrzakhan等人,2024年),并监测培训期间的进展情况(Liu等人,2025年;Hu等人,2025年;He等人,2025年;Bercovich等人,2025年;Luo等人,2025年)。 但这种简洁隐藏了一个基本问题:结论不仅取决于模型表现的好坏,还取决于基准问题如何分布Siska等人(2024年);张等人(2026年).

blocks.en: Consider first the leaderboard setting in Fig. 1 (a), where we want to compare two models. Suppose they perform similarly on easy questions but differ substantially on hard ones. If the benchmark places most of its weight on easy questions, while the difficulty distribution of interest places more weight on harder questions, the two evaluations can lead to different conclusions for the same pair of models: the benchmark may suggest that the two models are nearly tied, even though under the desired difficulty distribution they are clearly separated. Now consider the training setting in Fig. 1 (b), where we want to track whether a model is improving. Suppose the model improves substantially over a local difficulty range. If the benchmark has few or no questions in that region, the benchmark score may barely change, even though the model has made real progress.
blocks.zh: 先考虑图1(a)中的领导板设置,我们想在此比较两个模型。 假设它们在简单问题上表现相似,但在困难问题上却大相径庭。 如果基准将大部分权重放在容易的问题上,而困难的利息分配则使更难的问题更重,那么这两种评价可以导致对同一对模型的不同结论:基准可能表明这两种模型几乎是捆绑的,尽管在理想的难度分配下它们被明确分开. 现在考虑图1(b)中的培训设置,我们想在图1(b)中跟踪一个模式是否在改进。 假设这个模型在局部难度范围内有大幅改进. 如果基准在该区域没有或几乎没有问题,基准得分几乎不会改变,尽管该模式取得了实际进展。

blocks.en: These two failure cases suggest that benchmark conclusions depend critically on how questions are distributed. To study this structure systematically, we organize benchmark questions along a difficulty axis, which provides a natural progression from easier to harder problems. The key conceptual step is to use difficulty as a way to define the distributional structure of the benchmark itself. This view recasts a benchmark from a collection of test questions into an empirical measure over difficulty, with each question contributing equal evaluation mass at its difficulty level.
blocks.zh: 这两个失败案例表明,基准结论关键取决于问题如何分配。 为了系统地研究这一结构,我们沿着一个困难轴线组织基准问题,这提供了从比较容易的问题向更困难的问题的自然演变。 关键的概念步骤是将难度作为界定基准本身的分布结构的一种方法. 这种观点将一个基准从收集测试问题改为经验性衡量,而不是困难,每个问题都在其困难层次上提供平等的评价质量。

blocks.en: This measure-theoretic formalization is useful because it turns the two failure cases above into precise and analyzable problems about the benchmark-induced difficulty measure. The first is a measure mismatch problem: the benchmark may distribute its mass differently from the target difficulty distribution that represents the intended evaluation objective, so benchmark conclusions can differ from the conclusions under the target difficulty distribution. The second is a coverage gap problem. Because the benchmark is an empirical measure supported only on finitely many difficulty points, there may be intervals of difficulty with little or no benchmark mass. A substantial performance gain concentrated in such an interval may therefore produce little or no change in the benchmark score. To our knowledge, this is the first work to identify and formalize measure mismatch and coverage gaps as two fundamental failure modes of benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh: 这种计量理论形式化是有用的,因为它将上面的两个故障情况转化为关于基准引起的困难计量的精确和可分析的问题。 第一个是计量不匹配问题:基准的质量分配可能不同于代表预定评价目标的目标难度分配,因此基准结论可以与目标难度分配下的结论不同. 第二个问题是覆盖面差距问题。 由于基准是一种经验性衡量标准,只支持有限的许多困难点,因此,可能存在困难间隔,几乎没有基准质量。 因此,集中在这种间隔期间的大量业绩收益可能对基准得分产生很小或没有变化。 据我们所知,这是确定和正式衡量不匹配和覆盖范围差距的第一项工作,是基准评价的两个基本失败模式。

blocks.en: These two problems naturally lead to two simple diagnostic metrics: the Wasserstein distance Villani and others (2009) between the benchmark measure and a target difficulty distribution, and the maximum gap between adjacent benchmark difficulty points. We provide theoretical results showing that these quantities directly characterize distributional mismatch and the detectability of localized improvements. Empirically, we analyze 25 popular benchmarks spanning 7 domains. We estimate question difficulty using Item Response Theory and compute the proposed metrics. Our results show that both issues are prevalent across benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 这两个问题自然导致了两个简单的诊断度量:在基准度量与目标难度分布之间的瓦瑟斯坦距离比利亚尼等人(2009年),以及相邻基准难度点之间的最大差距. 我们提供的理论结果表明,这些数量是分布不匹配和局部改进的可探测性的直接特征。 从经验上讲,我们分析了25项涵盖7个领域的普及基准。 我们使用项目响应理论来估计困难,并计算提议的衡量标准。 我们的结果显示,这两个问题在各种基准中普遍存在。

blocks.en: Our key contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce a new measure-based perspective on benchmark evaluation, representing a benchmark as an empirical measure over difficulty. This perspective formalizes measure mismatch and coverage gaps, motivates two diagnostic metrics, and yields rigorous theoretical guarantees. • We conduct an empirical study across 25 benchmarks spanning 7 domains, showing that both difficulty-distribution mismatch and large coverage gaps are widespread in current benchmarks. • We propose BenchFill , a difficulty-targeted gap-filling algorithm. With only three inserted items per benchmark, BenchFill reduces the sum of the top three difficulty gaps by 21.09 % 21.09\% – 38.88 % 38.88\% .

blocks.en: Benchmarks are often used not only for final model comparison, but also to monitor training progress ( He et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . However, training improvements are often local rather than uniform: a model may improve substantially over a particular difficulty range while improving only modestly elsewhere.

blocks.en: Recall that a benchmark score is an integral with respect to the benchmark empirical measure ν B \nu_{B} . Since ν B \nu_{B} is a discrete measure supported only on the finitely many benchmark difficulty points, it assigns zero mass to every interval that contains no benchmark item. Consequently, even if the model improves substantially on a nontrivial contiguous difficulty region, the benchmark score may not reflect this improvement when the region contains no benchmark item. In this sense, a benchmark can fail as a progress monitor when its local resolution is insufficient.

blocks.en: 3.1 Difficulty Estimation and Metrics Calculation
blocks.zh: 3.1 难以估计和计量

blocks.en:
To estimate benchmark item difficulty, one may be tempted to use each item’s average failure rate across models ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Wen et al., 2025 ) . However, item difficulty is inherently relative to model ability: it should depend not only on how many models fail an item, but also on how capable the models that fail or solve it are.
We therefore use Item Response Theory (IRT), an established psychometric framework ( Lord, 1952 ; Rasch, 1993 ) that has been widely adopted for difficulty estimation in LLM benchmark analysis ( Ding et al., 2024 ; Rodriguez et al., 2021 ; Hofmann et al., 2025 ; Kipnis et al., 2024 ; Polo et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . IRT models the probability that a model solves an item as a function of both model ability and item difficulty. In the commonly used one-parameter logistic model (1PL), each model j j is assigned an ability parameter θ j \theta_{j} , and each item i i is assigned a difficulty parameter b i b_{i} . The probability that model j j correctly solves item i i is modeled as Pr ⁡ ( Y i ​ j = 1 ) = σ ⁡ ( θ j − b i ) , \Pr(Y_{ij}=1)=\sigma(\theta_{j}-b_{i}), where σ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \sigma(\cdot) is the logistic function. Intuitively, items with larger b i b_{i} require higher model ability to be solved correctly, and the estimated b i b_{i} therefore provides a natural measure of item difficulty. For multiple-choice benchmarks, the model above can be naturally extended with a guessing parameter.

Models are first ordered by their overall capability aggregated across multiple domains, then divided into several approximately equal intervals along this ranking. We perform stratified sampling by selecting one model from each interval and additionally include a few models from both the top and bottom of the ranking to better capture the extremes of the capability spectrum. Each selected model is evaluated on each benchmark item with up to 32 32 rollouts using the model-recommended temperature and top- p p . In one dimension, this is equivalently the L 1 L_{1} distance between their ECDFs. We compute the maximum gap according to Eq. ( 1 ) and also report the sum of the five largest adjacent gaps as a reference metric. We provide posterior uncertainty analyses for both metrics in App. C.6 .

blocks.en: Tab. 1 shows that 10 out of 25 benchmarks have DDM ≥ 0.10 \mathrm{DDM}\geq 0.10 , indicating that their empirical difficulty distributions must be transported by an average distance of at least 10% of the full difficulty range to match the same-size uniform reference. These benchmarks therefore encode a strong implicit difficulty weighting: their aggregate scores are more sensitive to overrepresented difficulty regions and less sensitive to underrepresented ones. Non-uniformity is not inherently problematic when it matches the intended evaluation objective. However, when no such objective is specified, high-DDM leaderboard results should not be interpreted as difficulty-neutral comparisons. Instead, they reflect comparisons under the benchmark’s empirical difficulty weighting, so users should check whether this weighting matches the difficulty distribution relevant to their use case. App. D presents a simple benchmark calibration algorithm for moving a benchmark distribution closer to a chosen target.

blocks.en: One direct approach is to ask human experts to design new items at the target difficulty, but this process can be costly Rein (2024) ; Phan et al. (2025) . Motivated by recent work on LLM-assisted benchmark augmentation Cheng et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2025) ; Ying et al. (2024) ; Xia et al. (2024) , we instead use LLMs to rewrite existing benchmark items into new variants at targeted difficulty levels. This rewriting-based approach is scalable, uses existing items as local references for controlled difficulty adjustment, and helps preserve the format and style of the original benchmark. To ensure item quality, the final selected items are further validated by human experts. We next introduce BenchFill , a rewrite-and-annotate evolutionary search algorithm ( Sharma, ; Liu et al., 2026 ) for automated difficulty-targeted item rewriting. Alg. 2 gives the pseudocode, and Fig. 4 illustrates the procedure.

blocks.en: 4.3 Curated Gap-Filled Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.3 弥补缺口的基准

blocks.en: To provide a community resource for more reliable evaluation of future models and training methods, we further apply BenchFill to construct gap-filled variants of four widely used math benchmarks with substantial coverage gaps: AMC23, AIME24, AIME25, and AIME26. We expand these benchmarks from 40, 30, 30, and 30 items to 80, 50, 52, and 53 items, respectively. All generated items are manually reviewed, and low-quality or incorrect items are discarded. We release the resulting variants as AMC23-BenchFill , AIME24-BenchFill , AIME25-BenchFill , and AIME26-BenchFill 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/datasets/Yifan99/BenchFill . As shown in Fig. 5 , these variants substantially reduce the largest original coverage gaps and bring the empirical difficulty distributions closer to a uniform distribution, providing more comprehensive coverage across the difficulty spectrum.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: A recent line of work has shifted attention from improving leaderboard scores to examining whether benchmark scores themselves provide reliable scientific evidence. Beyond data contamination, where benchmark test items appear in model training data and potentially inflate evaluation scores Oren et al. (2024) ; Sun et al. (2025) ; Zhu et al. (2024) , prior studies show that benchmark results can be sensitive to decoding, prompting, and implementation details Hochlehnert et al. (2025) , and brittle to surface wording or dataset flaws Mousavi et al. (2026) . Other work studies evaluation reliability through the lens of signal and noise Heineman et al. (2025) , or proposes broader benchmark-quality criteria and shows that widely used benchmarks vary substantially in quality Qian et al. (2026) . Our work complements these efforts by formulating a benchmark as an empirical measure over difficulty, enabling us to rigorously formalize measure mismatch and coverage gaps.
blocks.zh: 最近一行的工作将注意力从改进领导板分数转移到审查基准分数本身是否提供可靠的科学证据. 除了数据污染之外,在模型培训数据中出现基准测试项目,并可能提高评价分数 Oren等人(2024年);Sun等人(2025年);Zhu等人(2024年),先前的研究表明,基准结果对解码、催化和执行细节Hochlehnert等人(2025年)以及对表面措辞或数据集缺陷的微调(2026年)。 其他工作研究通过信号和噪音海尼曼等人(2025年)的镜头评价可靠性,或提出更广泛的基准质量标准,并表明广泛使用的基准在质量方面差异很大。 我们的工作补充了这些努力,制定了基准,作为克服困难的经验性衡量标准,使我们能够严格确定衡量不匹配和覆盖面差距的标准。

blocks.en: IRT originated in psychometrics as a framework for educational and psychological measurement Embretson and Reise (2013) ; Lord (2012) . In NLP, Lalor et al. (2016) introduced IRT to system evaluation, and Rodriguez et al. (2021) extended this perspective to leaderboard analysis. IRT has since become a widely used foundation for difficulty-aware evaluation in LLM benchmarking. Easy2Hard-Bench Ding et al. (2024) uses IRT to assign standardized continuous difficulty labels to benchmark items; it also validates these labels against human pairwise judgments and reports stronger alignment than GPT-4-based difficulty annotators. Zhou et al. (2026) uses an IRT-based framework to analyze the measurement quality of existing LLM benchmarks.
blocks.zh: IRT起源于心理计量学,作为教育和心理计量的框架. Embrettson and Reise (2013); Lord (2012). 在NLP中,Lalor等人(2016年)将IRT引入系统评价,Rodriguez等人(2021年)将这一视角扩展至领导板分析. 从那时起,IRT已成为LLM基准中广泛使用的困难意识评价的基础. 慢点,慢点 Ding等人(2024年)使用IRT为基准项目指定标准化的连续难度标签;它也对照人对偶判断验证这些标签,并报告比基于GPT-4的难度注释器更强的对齐性. Zhou等人(2026年)使用基于IRT的框架分析现有LLM基准的测量质量.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we view each benchmark as an empirical measure over difficulty. This perspective enables us to formalize measure mismatch and coverage gaps, leading to theoretical results and practical diagnostics.
We believe this empirical-measure view has the potential to open new ways to rigorously study and rethink benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们把每个基准视为克服困难的经验性衡量标准。 这种观点使我们能够正式衡量不匹配和覆盖面差距,从而得出理论结果和实际诊断。
我们认为,这种经验衡量观点有可能为严格研究和重新考虑基准评价开辟新的途径。

blocks.en: A.1 Broader Impacts
blocks.zh: A.1 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: This work aims to improve the reliability and transparency of benchmark evaluation. By diagnosing distribution mismatch and coverage gaps, our methods can help researchers better understand when benchmark scores provide faithful evidence for model comparison and monitoring training progress. More reliable evaluation may support more transparent model comparison and more informed benchmark design. Since this work focuses on benchmark analysis rather than model deployment or data collection, we do not foresee direct negative societal impacts.
blocks.zh: 这项工作旨在提高基准评价的可靠性和透明度。 通过诊断分布不匹配和覆盖面差距,我们的方法可以帮助研究人员更好地了解基准分数何时为模型比较和监测培训进展提供忠实的证据。 更可靠的评价可能有助于更透明的模型比较和更知情的基准设计。 由于这项工作侧重于基准分析,而不是模型部署或数据收集,我们没有预见到直接的社会负面影响。

blocks.en: A.2 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: A.2 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: This work develops a measure-theoretic view of benchmark evaluation and uses it to characterize two central issues: measure mismatch and coverage gaps. Our goal is not to exhaust all consequences of this viewpoint, but to show that benchmark evaluation can be studied through the geometry of the empirical difficulty measure induced by the benchmark. We believe this perspective opens a broader direction for studying benchmark evaluation, where additional benchmark failures and design objectives can be formulated as properties of the induced difficulty measure.
blocks.zh: 这项工作发展了基准评价的计量理论观点,并用它来描述两个核心问题:计量不匹配和覆盖面差距。 我们的目标不是要穷尽这一观点的所有后果,而是要表明基准评估可以通过基准引发的经验性难度计量的几何来研究. 我们认为,这种观点为研究基准评价开辟了更广泛的方向,在基准评价中,更多的基准失败和设计目标可以作为所引发的困难计量的属性制定。

blocks.en: Moreover, our current framework is primarily post-hoc: given an existing benchmark, we estimate its difficulty distribution, diagnose measure mismatch and coverage gaps, and reduce pronounced gaps through targeted item insertion. A natural next step is to move this perspective into the benchmark construction stage itself. Rather than auditing mismatch and coverage only after a benchmark has been built, benchmark developers can actively design the induced difficulty structure from the beginning, aiming to align the benchmark measure with the intended evaluation objective while maintaining high local resolution along the difficulty axis. We view this as a promising direction for difficulty-aware benchmark design.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们目前的框架主要是事后框架:根据现有的基准,我们估计其难度分布,诊断不匹配和覆盖面差距,并通过有针对性地插入项目来缩小已宣布的差距。 下一个自然步骤是将这一视角引入基准建设阶段本身。 基准开发者可以从一开始就积极设计所引发的困难结构,而不是仅仅在基准建立后审计不匹配和覆盖范围,目的是使基准计量与预期评价目标保持一致,同时沿困难轴保持高局部分辨率。 我们认为,这是制定有难度基准的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: A.3 Extended Related Work
blocks.zh: A.3 扩展相关工作

blocks.en:
Prior work often derives difficulty labels from human judgment or benchmark metadata. For example, MATH [ 18 ] annotates problems with five difficulty levels, GPQA [ 51 ] collects post-hoc expert difficulty ratings, and LingOly [ 5 ] includes five levels of human difficulty. Such labels are costly to obtain at scale, and they primarily reflect human-perceived difficulty rather than the difficulty exhibited by current LLMs on the questions. Recent work has explored alternative estimation strategies. [ 77 ] estimate LLM-perceived question difficulty from hidden representations. [ 4 ] ask an LLM to make pairwise difficulty judgments and aggregate them with Bradley–Terry scores. EIP [ 73 ] instead jointly infers question difficulty and model competency from observed successes and failures on a model–question bipartite graph. Complementarily, LoRe [ 71 ] studies intrinsic problem complexity, defined by the minimum number of computational steps required to solve a problem.
Among these approaches, IRT remains a common foundation for difficulty-aware evaluation because it provides a principled probabilistic framework for jointly modeling item difficulty and model ability directly from response data [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
先前的工作往往从人类判断或基准元数据中获得困难标签。 例如,MATH [18] 注释了5个难度等级的问题,GPQA [51] 收集了HOC后专家难度等级,LingOly [5] 包括了5个人类难度等级. 这种标签在规模上是昂贵的,它主要反映了人类所感受到的困难,而不是当前有关这些问题的法学硕士所表现出的困难。 最近的工作探讨了其他的估计战略。 [77] 估计LLM-透视问题难度来自隐藏表述. [4] 要求 LLM 进行双向难度判断,并将其与 Bradley - Terry 分数汇总. 相反,EIP[73]从一个模型-问题双方图上共同推断出所观察到的成败中存在的困难和示范能力。 作为补充,Lore [71]研究内在问题的复杂性,其定义是解决问题所需的最低计算步骤数量.
在这些方法中,IRT仍然是意识到困难的评价的共同基础,因为它为直接从响应数据中联合建模项目难度和模型能力提供了一个原则性概率框架[9].

blocks.en: For non-agentic tasks, we select models based on the overall leaderboard of Text Arena, whose evaluation suite covers a diverse set of domains including Expert , Hard Prompts , Coding , Math , Creative Writing , Instruction Following , and Longer Query . The overall score therefore provides a reasonable proxy for model capability across a broad range of tasks. To obtain models with diverse capability levels, we partition the leaderboard into 10 equal-width tiers according to the overall score. We then randomly select one model from each tier and additionally include one model from both the top and bottom of the leaderboard. This results in a total of 12 models spanning a wide spectrum of capabilities. The detailed model information is summarized in Tab. 4 .
blocks.zh: 对于非代理性任务,我们选择基于Text Arena总体领导板的模型,其评价套件涵盖一系列不同的领域,包括专家、硬提示、编码、数学、创造性写作、指导跟随和较长的查询。 因此,总体分数为各种任务的模型能力提供了合理的代用。 为了获得具有不同能力水平的模型,我们根据总体分数将领板分为10个等宽级. 然后我们随机从每个级别中选择一个模型,并额外包括来自领导板上下层的一个模型. 这导致共有12个模型跨越了广泛的能力范围。 详细的模型信息摘要载于Tab。 4 (英语).

blocks.en: To obtain reliable difficulty estimates, we conduct several diagnostic checks on both the response matrices and the IRT fitting procedure.
blocks.zh: 为了获得可靠的困难估计,我们对反应矩阵和IRT配制程序进行了几次诊断检查。

blocks.en:
We examine each response matrix using four diagnostics. The first two, model information and item information , measure whether the matrix contains enough discriminative signal along the model and item dimensions [ 3 ] .
The latter two, model inversion rate and item inversion rate , measure how well the empirical response matrix agrees with the monotone structure implied by 1PL-IRT [ 57 , 58 ] .

blocks.en: To evaluate whether the response matrix is consistent with the ordering implied by 1PL-IRT, we first rank models by overall success rate and items by overall solve rate. We then compute two inversion rates. The model inversion rate is the fraction of ordered model pairs, evaluated item by item, for which a stronger model performs worse than a weaker one. The item inversion rate is the fraction of ordered item pairs, evaluated model by model, for which an easier item is solved less often than a harder one. Lower inversion rates indicate better agreement with the latent ordering assumed by IRT.
blocks.zh: 为了评价响应矩阵是否与1PL-IRT所隐含的订单一致,我们首先以整体成功率对模型进行排名,然后以整体解析率对项目进行排名. 然后我们计算两个反转率。 模型反转率是订购的模型对数的分数,逐项评估,对于这个分数,较强的模型表现比较弱的. 项反转率是订购项对的分数,按型号评价模型,为此较容易项比较难解决的少. 较低的反转率表明,更符合IRT假设的潜在订单。

Passing these checks provides evidence that the matrix contains sufficient signal and is reasonably consistent with the ordering assumptions of IRT.

blocks.en: To assess convergence and sampling quality, we monitor 3 3 standard MCMC diagnostics: the maximum Gelman–Rubin statistic R ^ \hat{R} across parameters, the minimum bulk effective sample size (ESS), and the number of divergent transitions. Divergent transitions indicate potential numerical or geometric pathologies during NUTS sampling, and zero divergent transitions are preferred.

blocks.en: For each non-agentic benchmark, we assess the robustness of IRT-based difficulty estimation by performing a leave-one-out analysis over the selected model set. Specifically, given the 12 12 selected models, we refit IRT 12 12 times, each time removing one model and re-estimating item difficulties from the remaining 11 11 models. We then compare the resulting difficulty estimates with the original estimates obtained from all 12 12 models using Pearson and Spearman correlations. For each benchmark, we report both the average and the minimum correlation across the 12 12 leave-one-out refits. As shown in Tab. 7 , the average Pearson and Spearman correlations are at least 0.9723 0.9723 and 0.9704 0.9704 , respectively, across all benchmarks. Even the worst-case leave-one-out correlation remains high, with the minimum Pearson and Spearman correlations being 0.9137 0.9137 and 0.9089 0.9089 , respectively. These results indicate that the estimated item difficulties are stable to the exclusion of any single model, supporting the adequacy of our 12 12 -model selection for stable difficulty estimation.
blocks.zh: 对于每个非代理基准,我们通过对选定的一套模型进行一停一停的分析,评估基于IRT的难度估计的稳健性。 具体来说,考虑到12个选定的12个模型,我们12次重置IRT 12次,每次从其余11个模型中去掉一个模型并重新评估项目困难. 然后我们用皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼的相互关系来比较由此得出的难度估计和从所有12个模型中获得的原始估计. 就每个基准而言,我们报告12个 " 一放一放 " 调整的平均和最低相关性。 如塔布所示. 7,在所有基准中,平均皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼的相互关系分别为至少0.9723 0.9723和0.9704 0.9704. 甚至最坏的一离不开的关联性仍然很高,皮尔逊和斯皮尔曼的最低关联性分别为0.9137 0.9137和0.9089 0.9089. 这些结果表明,估计项目困难是稳定的,排除了任何单一模型,证明我们12个12个模型的选择足以进行稳定的困难估计。

C.5 Model Comparison for Different Difficulty Estimation Models
blocks.zh: C.5 不同难度估计模型的模型比较

blocks.en: Our empirical analysis relies on a scalar 1PL IRT difficulty estimate. To assess whether this modeling choice is supported by the response data, we compare 1PL against more flexible IRT specifications, including 2PL and multidimensional IRT models.
blocks.zh: 我们的经验分析依赖于一个Scalar 1PL IRT难度估计. 为了评估这种模型选择是否得到响应数据的支持,我们比较了1PL与更灵活的IRT规格,包括2PL和多维IRT模型.

blocks.en: We first compare 1PL and 2PL using Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC), where lower BIC is preferred. As shown in Tab. 8 , BIC selects 1PL for 21 out of the 25 benchmarks, often by large margins. This indicates that for most benchmarks, adding item-specific discrimination parameters is not supported after accounting for model complexity.
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用Bayesian Information Criterion(BIC)来比较1PL和2PL,这里更偏爱BIC. 如塔布所示. 8,BIC在25个基准中为21个选择了1PL,常常是大差幅. 这表明,对于大多数基准,在考虑模型复杂性之后,不支持增加具体项目的歧视参数。

blocks.en: For the remaining four benchmarks where BIC favors 2PL, the 2PL fits exhibit problematic sampling diagnostics, while the corresponding 1PL fits remain well-behaved. Tab. 9 reports the convergence diagnostics for these cases. For example, on Gaokao2023en, the 2PL fit produces max R ^ = 1.06 \hat{R}=1.06 , min bulk ESS = 63 =63 , and 983 divergent transitions, whereas the 1PL fit has max R ^ = 1.01 \hat{R}=1.01 , min bulk ESS = 569 =569 , and zero divergent transitions. Similar issues appear for AIME24, AIME25, and AMC23. Therefore, although 2PL is occasionally favored by BIC, these 2PL fits do not provide reliable alternative difficulty estimates.

blocks.en: We also evaluate multidimensional IRT models with two and three latent dimensions, denoted MIRT-2 and MIRT-3. Tab. 10 reports convergence diagnostics on the 15 smaller benchmarks. Overall, these multidimensional fits do not provide stable posterior estimates: most runs have maximum R ^ \hat{R} well above the standard convergence threshold of 1.05 and extremely small minimum bulk ESS, indicating poor mixing. On larger benchmarks, the multidimensional models are substantially more expensive and did not complete reliably within our fitting budget under the same Bayesian fitting procedure. Thus, the current response matrices do not support stable multidimensional difficulty estimates for our empirical analysis.
blocks.zh: 我们还评估具有两个和三个潜在维度的多维IRT模型,即MIRT-2和MIRT-3。 标签10报告了对15个较小基准的趋同诊断。 总的来说,这些多层面的适应性不能提供稳定的后期估计:大多数运行的最大R ^\hat{R}远高于1.05的标准汇合阈值和极小的零散ESS,表明混合性差. 在更大的基准上,多层面模式的费用要高得多,而且没有按照同样的巴耶西亚适用程序可靠地完成我们的适当预算。 因此,目前的反应矩阵不支持我们的经验分析中稳定的多层面困难估计。

blocks.en: Overall, these model-comparison results support the use of 1PL as a reliable difficulty estimation model for our study. While more complex IRT specifications may be useful in other settings, our diagnostics indicate that 1PL provides the most stable and well-supported difficulty estimates for the response matrices analyzed here.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些模型比较结果支持使用1PL作为我们研究的可靠困难估计模型. 虽然更复杂的IRT规格在其他环境中可能有用,但我们的诊断表明,1PL为本文分析的反应矩阵提供了最稳定和最有根据的难度估计。

blocks.en: C.6 Posterior Uncertainty Analysis
blocks.zh: C.6 不确定性分析

blocks.en: We further quantify how posterior uncertainty in the fitted IRT difficulty estimates affects our calculated metrics. For each posterior draw of the fitted 1PL item difficulties, we recompute DDM \mathrm{DDM} and Max ​ Gap \mathrm{Max\ Gap} , and summarize the posterior variability of these metrics across draws.

blocks.en: Across the 25 benchmarks, the posterior standard deviation of DDM \mathrm{DDM} is typically about 0.011, with range 0.006–0.020. This is small relative to the DDM \mathrm{DDM} point estimates, corresponding to approximately 8%–12% in typical cases. blocks.en: Max ​ Gap \mathrm{Max\ Gap} has larger posterior uncertainty, as expected, because it is an extreme-order statistic [ 11 ] : it is defined by the largest adjacent spacing between item difficulties and is therefore more sensitive to local posterior perturbations. Its posterior standard deviation ranges from 0.017 to 0.041. However, the qualitative coverage-gap conclusion remains robust. To verify this, we compare the observed Max ​ Gap \mathrm{Max\ Gap} against a same-size uniform-sampling baseline under posterior difficulty draws. Across benchmarks, the posterior probability that the observed Max ​ Gap \mathrm{Max\ Gap} exceeds the same-size uniform baseline has median 0.999. blocks.en: Experimental results are reported in Tab. 11 . The results show that our calibration algorithm improves the agreement between the source benchmark ranking and the leave-one-out reference ranking. On average, calibration improves Spearman correlation from 0.890 0.890 to 0.930 0.930 , and Kendall correlation from 0.802 0.802 to 0.848 0.848 . The improvement is especially pronounced on benchmarks with weaker initial agreement. Notably, on Minerva-Math, the full benchmark achieves only 0.601 0.601 Spearman and 0.455 0.455 Kendall correlation with the reference ranking, while calibration improves them to 0.790 0.790 and 0.667 0.667 , respectively. Similarly, on Gaokao2023en, calibration improves Spearman from 0.888 0.888 to 0.951 0.951 and Kendall from 0.788 0.788 to 0.879 0.879 . For the remaining benchmarks, the initial agreement is already high, leaving less room for improvement; nevertheless, calibration consistently preserves this high level of agreement while using the pruned benchmark.

blocks.en: For each benchmark, we focus on the three most pronounced gaps in its estimated difficulty distribution and rewrite one item for each gap. Since an LLM may not reliably distinguish small numerical differences on the normalized [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] difficulty scale when the target difficulty is provided in the prompt, we rescale difficulty values to [ 0 , 10 ] [0,10] for prompting while keeping all reported metrics on the original normalized scale.
blocks.zh: 对于每个基准,我们侧重于其估计难度分布中最显著的三个差距,并重写每个差距的一个项目。 由于在即时提供目标难度时,LLM可能无法可靠地区分正常化的[0,1][0,1]难度尺度上的小数值差异,因此我们将难度值重新调整为[0,10][0,10],以示提示,同时将所有报告的指标保持在原正常化尺度上.

blocks.en: For the reference list, we include nearby item–difficulty pairs on both sides of the target difficulty. Specifically, half of the reference items are selected from those with difficulty below the target and closest to it, and the other half are selected from those with difficulty above the target and closest to it. This provides the rewriter with local bidirectional context around the desired difficulty level. The full rewriter prompt template is provided below.
blocks.zh: 对于参考列表,我们包括了目标难度两侧的附近的项目-困难对. 具体来说,半数的参考项目选自目标以下困难且最接近的目标,另一半选自目标以上困难且最接近的目标. 这使重写器在想要的难度级别周围具有本地双向上下文. 全文重写即时模板如下。

blocks.en: For difficulty annotation, we use the same set of LLMs and the same generation configuration as in the original difficulty estimation stage. The search stops early if the best valid item found so far is within tolerance τ = 0.01 \tau=0.01 of the target difficulty on the normalized [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] scale, or otherwise stops after the maximum number of rounds. Before being inserted into the benchmark, each selected item undergoes a manual validity check by at least three human experts, who verify its correctness.

blocks.en: We ensure the reliability of the generated gap-filling items using a two-stage validation process. GPT-5.4 first serves as an automatic validity judge, checking whether each candidate is well-formed and whether its reference answer is correct; candidates that fail this check are discarded and regenerated. Human experts then independently audit the final selected items. Across the 24 target gaps, one initially proposed candidate failed the GPT-5.4 check because of an incorrect reference answer and was regenerated. All 24 final selected items passed the GPT-5.4 validity check and subsequently passed human review without modification or replacement.
blocks.zh: 我们利用两个阶段的验证程序,确保所生成的填充缺口项目的可靠性。 GPT-5.4首先担任自动有效性裁判,检查每位候选人是否身材良好,其参考答案是否正确;未通过这一检查的候选人被抛弃并重新生成. 之后,人类专家对最后选定的项目进行独立审计。 在24个目标缺口中,一个最初提议的候选人由于参考答案不正确而未能通过GPT-5.4检查,并重新生成。 所有24个最终选定的项目都通过了GPT-5.4有效性检查,随后通过了人文审查,没有修改或替换.

blocks.en: A natural question is whether our rewriter indeed perceives difficulty, instead of hitting the target difficulty blindly. We examine this question from two complementary angles: whether the rewriter already shows difficulty sensitivity before iterative feedback, and whether the subsequent search-and-annotate loop further improves alignment with the target difficulty.
blocks.zh: 一个自然的问题是,我们的改写是否真的意识到困难,而不是盲目地击中目标困难。 我们从两个互补的角度来研究这个问题:重写在迭代反馈之前是否已经显示难度敏感度,以及后续的搜索和通知循环是否进一步改善了与目标难度的配合.

blocks.en: First, to isolate the rewriter’s own difficulty perception from later IRT feedback and iterative search, we analyze only the first generation round of each gap-filling case. At this stage, the rewriter is conditioned on the specified target difficulty, but has not yet received feedback on the annotated difficulties of its generated children. Fig. 7 shows the specified target difficulty and the annotated difficulty of valid first-round children across all 8 benchmarks and 3 target gaps per benchmark. Within most benchmarks, higher specified targets produce higher mean annotated difficulties, and well-separated targets usually induce distinct child-difficulty distributions. This indicates that the rewriter already has non-trivial sensitivity to the specified difficulty scale before iterative feedback is introduced.
blocks.zh: 首先,为了将重写者自身的难度感知从后来的IRT反馈和迭代搜索中分离出来,我们只分析每个填充漏洞的病例的第一代. 在现阶段,重写以指定目标难度为条件,但尚未收到对其生成的儿童附加说明的困难的反馈. 费格。 7显示所有8个基准和每个基准3个目标差距的首轮有效儿童的具体困难和附加说明的困难。 在大多数基准内,较高具体指标产生较多的附加说明的平均值困难,而分离良好的指标通常会引起明显的儿童困难分布。 这表明在引入迭代反馈之前,重写器已经对指定的难度尺度具有非三角敏感性.

blocks.en: Second, we examine whether the search-and-annotate loop further improves target alignment. Fig. 8 shows one representative gap-filling case from each benchmark. Across these cases, the mean absolute target deviation generally decreases from the first round to the final round, and in most cases the generated children also become more concentrated around the target. This suggests that the iterative loop further refines the rewriter’s initial difficulty signal using IRT annotation and updated memory.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们审查搜索和通知循环是否进一步改善目标对齐。 图8显示每个基准中有一个代表性的补缺案例。 在这些案件中,平均绝对目标偏差一般从第一轮降至最后一轮,在大多数情况下,产生的儿童也更加集中在目标周围。 这表明,迭代循环利用IRT注释和更新内存,进一步完善了重写器的初始难度信号.

blocks.en: We further examine whether BenchFill improves a benchmark’s ability to detect localized model improvements beyond reducing difficulty gaps. We consider one target gap in each of AIME24, AIME25, and AIME26, and compare three benchmark variants: Original , Original + BenchFill , and Original + Baseline . Both augmentation methods insert exactly one item into the original benchmark. We perform mild SFT so that the model improves around the target gap region. Each item is evaluated with 32 rollouts before and after SFT, and we test whether the gain is statistically detectable using a one-sided stratified randomization test ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查Fill是否提高一个基准的能力,以发现除减少困难差距之外的地方性模型改进。 我们考虑了AIME24、AIME25和AIME26各一个目标差距,并比较了三个基准变体:原始的、原始的 + 基准的、和原始的 + 基线的。 两种扩增方法在原基准中都插入了一个项目。 我们执行温和的SFT,以便模型在目标差距区域周围改进. 每个项目在SFT前后经过32次推广评估,我们通过单侧分层随机化测试(p < 0.05 p < 0.05)来测试收益是否在统计学上可以检测.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 12 , Original + BenchFill detects a positive post-SFT gain in all three cases (3/3), while Original and Original + Baseline detect none (0/3 each). This shows that BenchFill is not merely improving the metric it optimizes; by filling under-covered difficulty regions, it makes the benchmark more sensitive to localized model improvements that would otherwise be missed.
